description: Move a shot (shot_id) to another position, in its own scene or into another scene (scene is where it goes). The shot keeps all its settings. One undo step for the person. Returns { done, shot }. To copy instead of move, use duplicate.

before.description: Put it before this shot id.

index.description: Or: its new position in the scene, from 0. Left out (and no before): the end.

scene.description: Target scene id or index. Left out: its own scene.

shot_id.description: The shot to move (its id from get_project).

name: move
